change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, AKRON FORMULATIONS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED는 품질관리부서 권한과 원료 공급업체 적격성 관리가 미흡했고, 다수 완제품에서 Burkholderia cepacia complex 시험 및 보존효력시험이 누락되었습니다. 이에 품질부서는 원료·배치 처분·조사를 재검토하고, 시험실은 미생물 규격과 시험체계를 보완해야 하며, 미국 유통제품의 위험평가·고객통지·회수 가능성이 업무에 영향을 줍니다.

impact_summary.value: 공급업체 적격성·품질관리단위 감독, 미생물 시험과 실험실 관리가 불충분해 제품의 정체성·함량·품질·순도와 미생물학적 안전성을 보장하지 못하며, 유통 제품에 잠재적 오염 위험이 있습니다.

evidence.quote: You did not adequately establish laboratory controls to ensure all drug products you manufactured possessed appropriate quality attributes, (b)(4) , or (b)(4) systems to ensure their microbiological quality and safety.
The records and information you provided indicate that you did not test numerous drug product batches for Burkholderia cepacia complex (BCC) organisms.

affected_work.value: Akron Formulations India의 OTC 의약품 제조·출하와 품질관리 업무가 대상입니다. 공급업체 및 원료 적격성, 배치별 미생물 시험, 실험실 관리, 시설·자재 보관, 공정·세척 밸리데이션과 안정성 관리가 포함됩니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm failed to establish an adequate quality control unit with the responsibility and authority to approve or reject all components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, packaging materials, labeling, and drug products (21 CFR 211.22(a)).

Your firm failed to establish laboratory controls that include scientifically sound and appropriate specifications, standards, sampling plans, and test procedures designed to assure that components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, labeling, and drug products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality, and purity (21 CFR 211.160(b)).

recommendation.value: FDA는 품질관리단위의 권한·자원 보강 계획, 실험실과 제조·미생물 위험 평가, 유효기간 내 제품의 위험 평가 및 필요 시 고객 통지·회수를 요구합니다. 또한 미생물 배치 출하시험과 보관검체 시험 결과 등 구체 자료를 제출하고, 적격 컨설턴트의 종합 6개 시스템 감사를 받으라고 권고합니다.

evidence.quote: A detailed risk assessment addressing the hazards posed by distributing drug products with potentially objectionable contamination. Specify actions you will take in response to the risk assessment, such as customer notifications and product recalls.

Based upon the nature of the violations we identified at your firm, you should engage a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 to evaluate your operations and to assist your firm in meeting CGMP requirements. The qualified consultant should also perform a comprehensive six-system audit of your entire operation for CGMP compliance
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
